data.headline: Principal Developer
data.about:
Principal full-stack software engineer.  I'm comfortable working anywhere from the frontend/backend to the DevOps and system level (including Jenkins, linux, AWS, Docker, etc).  Proven history of delivering value. 

I prefer initial recruiter contacts to include some information upfront. 

Core languages: Python, SQL, Javascript, shell scripting (plus Java experience)
Core skillset: REST services & web applications (a bit stronger on backend than frontend), SQL databases, git, Linux, Docker, Jenkins CI, exposure to K8S

Specialization in scalability/performance and robust systems design. 
My professional contacts will often have similar backgrounds to the above.

description.text:
Contributed to developing API standards and project to roll out protobufs/gRPC for APIs

Impact: helped address a bad-actor problem that endangered email deliverability. Personally thanked by CTO for contribution

Tech stack: Python (Flask & SqlAlchemy), gRPC/protobufs, MySQL & BigQuery, GCP, DataDog, exposure to Ruby/Rails, CI/CD work with JenkinsX

(Departure due to being impacted by a layoff, along with a large fraction of my department.)

* Technical leader for a group of 5-7 teams, defining our technical and architecture strategy and driving roadmap for improving our tech base & engineering culture
* Supported numerous teams and individuals to help overcome technical or execution obstacles
* Collaborated with other principal developers to define standards & framework choices
* Scalability and performance expert: prioritised, led, and helped execute initiatives that cut API response time in half while also improving system resilience and scalability. Focus areas: DB query design, API design, system & infrastructure bottlenecks, Python service configuration tuning
    * My scalability work directly enabled the growth of large enterprise customers
* Interviewing: built a robust developer hiring process to enable us to identify and hire top talent, both handling interviews myself and training interviewers
* Mentored technical staff to build excellence & help achieve career goals
* Handled numerous business-critical production issues, providing long-term solutions to prevent them
* Provided technical-focused input to strategic decision-making for our highest-selling product

Tech stack: Python (Flask, uWSGI, SQL Alchemy), Redis, Postgres & MariaDB, AWS services, Docker + Kubernetes, New Relic & Kibana
Took time off for moving to Toronto, Canada from the USA and settling into the new country

Developer on a serverless application used by our business - Python backend on AWS Lambda, Vue.js frontend, Serverless Framework, CloudFormation, Jenkins deployments to AWS, DynamoDB,  PostgreSQL (RDS) with SQL Alchemy,  various AWS services (S3, API gateway etc), plus a bit of Docker

* Went beyond the call of duty to ensure we were able meet a critical deadline for payment distributions despite a data handling vendor failing to deliver on contract -- thanks to putting in crunch hours and some clever scripting we were able to carefully and cleanly process thousands of files in a fraction of the usual time
* Key part of automating the business process that was previously contracted out, including reliably and mostly automatically processing many highly non-standard Excel and delimited customer files
* Added AWS X-Ray performance tracing and used it to identify and mitigate a critical performance issue that degraded or broke user experience
* Added lambda prewarming and external-service data caching, improving app responsiveness 10x and increasing business user productivity 

Developer on a Django application -- Docker, Python,  PostgreSQL, Django, EC2 and the usual AWS stack, legacy Angular, Jenkins Deployment

Worked on a Java stack application: Java backend (Spring), persistence to PostgreSQL, legacy Angular frontend, deployed on AWS via Jenkins

DevOps: Advised company on further developing Jenkins CI/CD processes and helped with modernization, did some of the AWS work, did production troubleshooting and performance tuning as needed

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.subtitle: CloudBees . undefined
experiences.caption: May 2015 - Jan 2019 · 3 yrs 8 mos
experiences.metadata: Remote (most recent) + Raleigh-Durham (previous), North Carolina Area

description.text:
* Delivered multiple scalability wins for Jenkins Pipeline, by delivering Java optimizations, streamlining persistence, and using a self-created Dockerized performance testing framework
* Led investigation when one of our largest customers hit scalability challenges, culminating in an onsite visit that tapped expertise in both our Java codebase and Linux systems.  Authored solutions and best practices that saved our relationship with the customer and was praised by executives up to the CEO. 
* Solved scalability challenges for our largest customers (multiple Global 100 customers) with a thorough performance analysis.  Resulted in multiple blog posts, code changes, and best practices that enable our largest customers to continue growing their use of CloudBees Jenkins offerings.
*Took initiative to launch a new analysis/reporting library now being incorporated into multiple strategic projects
* Responsible for Jenkins pipeline stage view plugin since it has been open-sourced
  - Currently installed and used on 70,000+ active Jenkins servers
  - Optimizations to REST API improving performance over 100-fold with complex pipelines
  - Implemented small frontend enhancements & bugfixes from community & customers (Javascript, Java, HTML/CSS, and JQuery) 
* Upgraded Jenkins plugins to consume new workflow features, working with complex back-compatibility requirements (Java, JUnit)
* In depth work with Jenkins continuous integration jobs running in AWS infrastructure (and locally)
* Constructed a multi-container  Docker demonstration to showcase Jenkins Workflow in integration with Gerrit
   - Presented at local Java user group, and Google’s Gerrit User Summit 2015
   - Technologies: Java, Docker, Shell Script, Git, Jenkins, and Groovy
* Enhancements to cross-platform release packaging (Jenkins, shell script, makefiles, python, RPM & DEB packaging)
* Created new Dockerized continuous integration to enable testing linux packages

* Programmed business-critical RESTful Java web services and web applications running on JBoss/RHEL VMs, eventually rising to SME for this business system
* Added and extended APIs covering a suite of 30+ middleware services, including one that delivered a 10x performance improvement for managing subscriptions for Red Hat's largest customers.
* Administered and solved issues with production & development JBoss servers
* Major contributor in large project upgrading all SOA services to latest version of JBoss. 
* Implemented a complex data migration of all product DB data in SQL & PL/SQL, safely handling numerous, convoluted edge cases.  Reduced migration time from weeks to under an hour.
* Added reporting to a large business-critical and performance-critical Python application. 
* Created a smoke testing tool for REST services, now in use by other teams and a core component of  release and maintenance processes. 
* Lead for a greenfield project providing an application for monitoring and viewing DB health & statistics

Main languages/skills used: Java (extensive use), Git (extensive use), Java EE, REST, Spring, Angular, JSP, JBoss, Python, Bash, Linux administration, SQL. 

Began as contractor via Resolvit: March 2013-October 2013, under the Jr Java Developer title, then converted to permanent Red Hat employee with the current title.
Supported diverse application ecosystem.  Wrote knowledge base articles and training documentation.  Trained and assisted with setting up systems for new hires.
Hired as a team lead, promoted to assistant manager in under a year after strong performance.

projects.title: PyRestTest: HTTP Testing & Benchmarking Framework (Open source)
projects.subtitle: Apr 2014 - Present

description.text:
* New python framework for testing & benchmarking RESTful web services, using YAML and PyCurl.
* Created extensible generate / validate / extract features to enable complex test scenarios, and custom extension loading mechanism
* CI using a personal Jenkins server in AWS, with Github integration and unit, functional, and installation testing in custom Docker environments (using the Jenkins workflow DSL)
* Minimal dependencies to enable easy deployment, but also supports optional extensions for more complex functionality (including JSON schema validation)
